{{Quote|Recognize this axe? It was forged from your so-called ''Courageous''—when we began melting it down for scrap!|[[Mandalore the Ultimate]]|<ref name="DoH2" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] wielded a powerful '''battle-axe'''. Forged in the shape of a traditional [[Mythosaur axe/Legends|mythosaur axe]] with metals taken from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] prized [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']], after the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian's]] victory in the [[Battle of Serroco]], the battle-[[Axe/Legends|axe]] became a symbol of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore's]] prowess. With a long pole staff and the addition of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], as well as an [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]], Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe was twice as deadly as those traditionally constructed from [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]] [[Bone/Legends|bone]].

When Mandalore the Ultimate arrived aboard the ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]'' to meet with the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] leader [[Arkoh Adasca]], along with representatives of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Republic competing to obtain control of Adasca's [[Project Black Harvest]], he came face to face with Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]. Mandalore brandished his battle-axe at the meeting as spoils of war, taunting Karath with the remains of his former [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Courageous''. The meeting ultimately came to naught, and as the conference turned to open conflict between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Mandalore the Ultimate departed the Arkanian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with his battle-axe in [[Limb/Legends|hand]].

==Description==
[[Mandalore the Ultimate]]'s battle-[[Axe/Legends|axe]] was a modernized update of the ancient [[Mythosaur axe/Legends|mythosaur axe]] traditionally created by early [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. But while these traditional axes were constructed from calcified [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of the long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaurs]]<ref name="KotORCG" /> of the Mandalorian's cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] the Ultimate forged his own [[Melee weapon/Legends|weapon]] from metals salvaged and melted down from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], the [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']],<ref name="DoH2" /> as well as [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]].<ref name="KotORCG" /> When constructing the axe, Mandalore the Ultimate had the metal blades placed atop a lengthy pole staff, nearly as long<ref name="DoH2" /> as the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] warrior<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> was tall,<ref name="DoH2" /> and installed an [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] that enabled the axe to deliver a strong electric charge. With these features, Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe was capable of inflicting nearly twice the damage as traditional mythosaur axes made of bone. The weapon weighed ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] in total, and possessed an estimated value of 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="KotORCG" />

==History==
In [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the forces of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] [[Battle of Serroco|engaged]] the Galactic [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]]. After [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|bombarding]] the [[City/Legends|cities]] of the surface, the Mandalorians turned their attention to the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]],<ref name="DoF3">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ship]] ''Courageous''.<ref name="KotORCG" /> The Neo-Crusader [[Warship/Legends|warships]] overwhelmed the Republic [[Battle Group Serroco|battle group]], boarding and taking the ''Courageous'' as the crew was forced to evacuate and flee.<ref name="NoA2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 17|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 17]]</ref> Claiming their battle-won prize, the Mandalorians had the ''Courageous'' torn down and melted for scrap. Taking a share of the ''Courageous''{{'}} materials, the Mandalorian leader, Mandalore the Ultimate, forged a battle-axe<ref name="DoH2" /> in the shape of a traditional Mandalorian mythosaur axe.<ref name="KotORCG" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Mandalore was invited to a meeting with the leader of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] mega-corporation [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania|Adascorp]], [[Arkoh Adasca]], aboard the company's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] headquarters, the ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]''. There, Adasca offered representatives of the Republic, [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the Mandalorians the opportunity to take command of a [[Project Black Harvest|secret bio-weapons project]] he had cultivated. As Mandalore the Ultimate met face to face with Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]—the former commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the ''Courageous''—at the negotiations, he brandished the battle-axe he had forged and taunted Karath with the revelation of the weapon's origins.<ref name="DoH2" /> When [[Zayne Carrick|one]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] present at the meeting created a false scenario designed to make Mandalore the Ultimate believe he had become the target of an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt by Adasca, Mandalore took his battle-axe and departed the ''Arkanian Legacy'', while [[First Battle of Omonoth|violence]] broke out between his Neo-Crusader warriors and the Republic military and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="DoH3">[[Knights of the Old Republic 21|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 21]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 20|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 20]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. The axe appeared again in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 21|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 21]], and was featured in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.
